name: February 17, 2026 Regular Meeting
minutes_text:
MINUTES
  PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  FEBRUARY 17, 2026
  MULTIPURPOSE ROOM
  6:30 P.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Chair Villablanca called the meeting to order at 6:41 pm.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Chair Judy Villablanca; Vice Chair Jake Lingo; and Commissioner Alicia Peak

  ABSENT: Commissioners Dane Skophammer and Georgia Goldfarb

  ALSO PRESENT: Kristin Riesgo, Community Services Director; Kate Manisco,
  Recreation Manager; Chris Orosz, Interim Recreation Manager; and Brittany Saleaumua,
  Administrative Assistant

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Chair Villablanca led the Pledge of Allegiance.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Commissioner Peak moved, and Vice Chair Lingo seconded a motion to approve
  the agenda. The question was called, and the motion carried 3-0; Commissioners
  Goldfarb and Skophammer absent.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Administrative Assistant Saleaumua reported the agenda for the meeting was
  posted on February l2, 2026.

ITEM l  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIONS

  A.  Election of Chair and Vice Chair

  Chair Villablanca stated that the election of Chair and Vice Chair would be
  postponed to the next Regular meeting, as Commissioners Goldfarb and
  Skophamrner were absent.

ITEM 2  WRITTEN AND ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

  Haylynn Conrad inquired if the quarterly Recreation Guide was distributed to
  businesses and schools.

ITEM 3  CONSENT CALENDAR

MOTION  Commissioner Peak moved, and Vice Chair Lingo seconded a motion to approve
  the consent calendar. The question was called, and the motion carried 3-0;
  Commissioners Goldfarb and Skophammer absent.

  The Consent Calendar consisted of the following items:
  A.  Previously Discussed Items
  None.
  B.  New Items
  1.  Approval of Minutes
  Recommended Action: Approve the minutes for the November 18, 2025
  Parks and Recreation Commission Regular meeting.
  2.  Community Services Department Monthlv Report
  Recommended Action: Receive and file a report of activities, events,
  proj ects, and programs coordinated by the Community Services Department
  in January 2026.

ITEM 4  OLD BUSINESS

  None.

ITEM 5  NEW BUSINESS

  FIFA World Cul and Summer 2028 Olympic Programing
  Recommended Action: Review and provide feedback on potential community
  programs for the FIFA World Cup and Summer 2028 Olympic and Paralympic
  Games.

  Recreation Manager Manisco presented the staff report.

  In response to Chair Villablanca, Community Services Director Riesgo stated the
  Malibu Arts Commission had proposed a longboard surfing contest.

  Recreation Manager Manisco stated the Harry Barovsky Memorial Youth
  Commission proposed sports clinics, theming existing programs, sports fllm
  screenings, and supporting local businesses.

  Community Services Director Riesgo stated that the Malibu Arts Commission
  requested to install the 7-7-7 artwork, if it were available.
   Parks and Recreation Commission
  Regular Meeting
  Minutes of February 17, 2026
  Page 3 of 5

  Kevin Keegan stated he had discussed potential opportunities for the Summer 2028
  Olympic and Paralympic Games with previous management and supported
  discussions between the Harry Barovsky Memorial Youth Commission and Parks
  and Recreation Commission.

  Vice Chair Lingo supported Olympic programming and stated that former athletes
  may be interested in partnering with the city.

  Commissioner Peak stated that an Olympic-themed event for youth and seniors
  could be a wonderful opportunity.

  Community Services Director Riesgo stated that no budget is currently in place for
  any 2028 Olympics—related activities and that the City Council has not provided
  direction.

  In response to Chair Villablanca, Recreation Manager Manisco stated that staff
  would use existing programs such as Storytime and Nature Walk to incorporate a
  soccer theme or coordinate a CineMalibu sports movie series.

CONSENSUS
  By Consensus, the Commission recommended proceeding with gearing existing
  programs, where possible, to be soccer-themed and would wait for further direction
  from the City Council on 2028 Olympic-related activities.

  B.  Las Flores Creek Park
  Recommended Action: l) Receive a report on Las Flores Creek Park design
  elements, property boundaries, and constraints; and 2) Provide feedback on future
  discussion items related to park amenities.

  Scott Dittrich proposed placing a dog park on Rambla Pacifico Street.

  In response to Chair Villablanca, Community Services Director Riesgo stated that
  an addendum to the Initial Study would be required if amenities were relocated or
  added to the park.

  Commissioner Peak stated she wanted a dog park in Eastern Malibu, and it was not
  the Commission’s job to decide if a dog park was feasible at Las Flores Creek Park.
  She stated she was concemed about parking at Las Flores Creek Park.

  Vice Chair Lingo recommended staffresearch Las Flores Creek Park and determine
  whether a dog park was feasible and provide the Commission with information on
  how to incorporate it.

MOTION  Vice Chair Lingo moved, and Commissioner Peak seconded a motion to
  recommend that staff study and research Las Flores Creek Park to determine if a
  dog park was feasible, and report back to the Commission the process for
  implementing a dog park in addition to a cost estimate.

ITEM 6  STAFF UPDATES

  Recreation Manager Manisco provided an update on staff recognition and the
  Spring Recreation Guide.

  Interim Recreation Manager Orosz provided an update on Outdoor Recreation
  programs and Equestrian Park.

  Community Services Director Riesgo provided an update on the Skate Park, Malibu
  Bluffs Park Snack Shack, and Community Lands Project.

ITEM 7  COMMISSIONER REPORTS, COMMENTS AND INQUIRIES

  Commissioner Peak inquired if a pubic calendar could be created that would list
  field availability. She stated she was concerned about the City’s liability at the skate
  park during the week.

  Vice Chair Lingo stated that the Malibu Little League season had started. He
  thanked Interim Recreation Manager Orosz for his assistance with field
  coordination and communication. He requested a copy of the Commission’s Rules
  of ProCedure and Decorum and wanted to remind everyone of meeting decorum
  and procedures.

  In response to Chair Villablanca, Interim Recreation Manager Orosz stated the
  Malibu Bluffs Park pollinator garden would be installed on April 26, 2026, in
  partnership with the Santa Monica Mountains Fund.

  In response to Chair Villablanca, Community Services Director Riesgo stated that
  a Grand Opening for the Skate Park was being planned, but a date had not been set.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  Las Flores Creek Dog Park
  Rules of Procedure and Decorum

ADJOURNMENT

  Chair Villablanca adjourned the meeting at 8:23 p.m.
